PaperId.description:
A paper (a PDF in the library or a project).

Serialised as the UUID's canonical hyphenated string.

input.description:
A digest of a paper. Output of `workspace.get_digests`, input of `workspace.save_digest`
(and, for what was seen in its figures, of `get_figures` and `save_figures`).

data.description: The digest, as the engine that made it wrote it.

input.title: PaperDigest

summary: Keep what was seen in a paper's figures with it
